Table 15.15 Nutrition Therapy for IBS
• Avoid large meals
g
• Reduce lactose (eliminate milk, ice cream, and yogurt)
• Reduce fat to no more than 40 to 50 g/day
• Reduce sorbitol, mannitol, xylitol (mainly “sugarless” gum; read labels)
• Reduce fructose in all forms, including high-fructose corn syrup, honey,
and high-fructose fruits (e.g., dates, oranges, cherries, apples, and
pears)
• Reduce gas-producing foods (e.g., beans, peas, broccoli, cabbage,
and bran)
